thread:
ana: Kickoff: propose a "lite" observability deliverable for Console to hit by end of Q2. Must be low-risk, high-signal.

raj: Agree. What's in scope for "lite"?

ana: typo — ana: In-scope proposal: (A) three lightweight dashboards (latency by route p50/p95, cost rollup by model and route, errors by service + top error codes), (B) one tracing hook with low-overhead sampling & trace_id propagation, (C) a cost reconciliation test and short customer note.

claire: Add: an automated alert for sudden cost growth + a basic error triage playbook. Alerts should point to runbooks with mitigation steps (cache, lower-model, enable batching).

dmitri: For tracing, low overhead = deterministic sampling: 0.5% baseline, 100% for requests that result in a 5xx or an error event. Implement sample decision in edge proxy to reduce runtime overhead.

raj: Edge sampling helps. We should avoid per-token instrumentation for v1. Token counters can be approximated from request metadata and model config for now. Full token accounting is v1.1 work.

jen: Customer ask: customers want to see cost delta when they switch models. We need model-tagged events and a way to show before/after on the cost dashboard. That means metrics: `cost.tokens`, `cost.model_name`, `route`.

ana: again typo — ana: Noted. We'll use metric names with `redwood.*` prefix. Data infra: retention 30d for aggregated metrics, pre-aggregate hourly. Dmitri, can you confirm datapipeline cost for hourly aggregation?

dmitri: Yes. Hourly pre-agg and 30d retention is fine for v1. We'll provide a synthetic QA dataset for acceptance testing. ETA: Wed.

claire: On acceptance: require billing reconciliation job that runs in sandbox and asserts <12% discrepancy for model buckets. Also a perf guardrail: trace.enabled must not increase p99 by >5ms on canary.

raj: Runtime effort: instrument route tags + light sample hook in proxy + expose sample decisions in logs. Estimate 2.5 engineer-weeks if we exclude websocket streaming. Recommend we exclude websockets for v1.

ana: ana: Ok to exclude websockets, mark as v1.1. We'll call this out in launch notes.

jen: UX ask: the cost dashboard needs quick filters (by model, by route, by timeframe) and a simple toggle to show per-1000-requests cost. That should be doable with the dashboard templates.

dmitri: Ops window available: 2026-05-25 01:00-03:00 UTC for canary; full rollout 2026-05-26 02:00-05:00 UTC.

claire: Risks: (1) sampling config wrong -> blind spots, (2) cost buckets mismatch with billing, (3) trace export backpressure. Mitigations: adaptive sampling + a stress perf run + pre-aggregation QA.

raj: Action items: Eng (raj) to post RFC with trace sampling algorithm + metric names by Thu. Data (dmitri) provide QA set by Wed. Product (ana) draft customer cost explainer by Fri. SRE (claire) produce perf validation plan by Mon.

ana: ana: I'll coordinate and follow up in RFC thread. If we meet these, we can target the May deploy windows. Reaction if you support: :white_check_mark: :rocket:

raj: :white_check_mark:

claire: :rocket:

jen: :+1:

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved 2026-05-25 01:00-03:00 UTC.
